brief.en: Conjures meteor strikes from the sky that leaves molten tiles
brief.zh: 从空中召唤能融化地面的流星

description.en: Meteor Flower conjures meteor strikes from the sky that leave molten tiles.
description.zh: 流星花从天上召唤流星，砸地时留下岩浆。

chat.en: "Out of this world molten mayhem! But first... coffee!!"
chat.zh: “熔融的骚乱啊，滚出这个世界！但是在此之前……喝口咖啡！！”

text.en: meteors scare dinosaurs, forcing them to escape
text.zh: 流星惊吓恐龙，迫使它们逃跑
